THE BUILD GATE REDDED THIS CROSSING FIRST, and that is the story worth keeping. Crossing PROVEME forward runs the inspector on this component, and it refused: 3 charted_refs_resolve findings, all of them the address `chart`, charted by three voyages that closed three weeks ago. The derivation had cleared 362 -> 6 and then correctly stopped — git records where a FILE went and cannot say what a DISSOLUTION meant. Three commits earlier I had written the opposite into a commit message ('a thing that came apart has no successor') and the ticket outranks that: its falsifier says the genuine dissolutions are named on a ticket by a hand, and its gate (3) even names the answer. So thirteen hand entries across twelve tickets: chart and cairn/chart -> skills/chart (the charter moved there whole and now covers the skill AND the chain it calls); cairn/chart/proofs -> cairn/devices/builder/machines (measured: 12 proofs to 11 destinations, no plurality, 10 of them under builder/machines/<stage>/proofs). MEASURED AFTER: corpus address findings 6 -> 0, residue 17 -> 4 pairs, and the four are one CLAIMLESS orient packet — a packet naming no ticket has no ticket to carry an order, which is a structural floor rather than a hand's debt, and is owed a ticket. The four-way decomposition now reads: no door 362, hand door only 264, both doors 6, both doors plus the dissolution named 0. WHAT THE WATCH WATCHES, three directions, because a residue at zero is what a working derivation and a dead reader both look like: the residue grew; a forward LAUNDERED (resolved to a target not on disk — worse than the red it replaced); or the reading was VACUOUS (zero rename records), which counts toward NEITHER branch. ENOUGH IS ASYMMETRIC and was exercised here: one laundered forward satisfies alone (True); three vacuous readings never clear (False); three clean readings over an unchanged rename record do not clear (False), because a derivation that never had to keep up with anything has not been tested at its claim; three clean readings spanning a GROWN record do clear (True). THE PROBE CARRIES NO SECOND SPELLING — it imports rename_records / forwarding_residue / ref_exists from the inspector and holds no --diff-filter, no vote and no hand-order lookup (0 occurrences of each measured); its three hits on the word 'plurality' are prose. That is the address_rule precedent transferred: a probe carrying its own copy of the rule goes green against itself.

note: PROVED - the three address sieves have a SECOND successor door, and it is git's own record. THE NUMBER THAT MATTERS is the three-way decomposition, taken by disabling each door in turn because a single before/after cannot say which door did the work: no door at all 362 corpus address findings across 9 components; hand door only 264 across 6; both doors 6 across 2; both doors plus the one dissolution named by a hand, 0. Every per-sieve and per-component bucket falls monotonically - no regression anywhere. PRECEDENCE, and it is the design not a detail: the hand-authored order first (only a hand can speak for a dissolution), then git's transitive record for a FILE, then a strict-majority PLURALITY over the files that were under a DIRECTORY, with only suffix-preserving kids voting. Plurality rather than unanimity was measured, not chosen: 67 of base's 71 addresses answer under plurality against 64 under unanimity, and the three unanimity lost voted 6-1-1, 9-1 and 9-1, because a bulk move is never unanimous - the stragglers move separately. Both ends checked exactly as the hand door checks them. 444 rename records read; -M and -M -C return identical pair sets on this corpus; nothing persisted, an in-memory cache only. THE UNIT IS THE (ADDRESS, TICKET) PAIR, which is the voyage's real discovery: a forwarding order is one TICKET's record, and the same address is legitimately answered under one ticket and unanswered under another - cairn/chart/intention+why.json resolves under watchme-emits-a-probe's hand order and not at all for a claimless packet. Address-level accounting could never close, and two teeth went red saying so. Residue 423 asked / 419 answered / 4 residual, and the four are ONE claimless orient packet, which is a structural floor rather than a hand's debt. FOUR DEFECTS THE BUILD FOUND THAT THE FIXTURE HAD NOT: git's record is repo-relative while 29 of 38 residual addresses were spelled absolutely; the residue walk iterated TICKETS so a claimless packet never reached the derived door; the residue accepted an answer from any ticket that charted the address while the sieve asks only the charting ticket's order; and the accounting mixed pair counts with address counts. AND ONE THE MUTATION FOUND THAT NEITHER HAD: tooth (c) passed with the live-address guard deleted outright, because it asked about a rename TARGET, which has no chain to follow - it was measuring git's silence rather than the resolver's refusal. The fixture now brings a name back from the dead. All six seeded cases now red on their own tooth and nothing else's. THE BUILD GATE CAUGHT THIS VOYAGE TWICE: once at the PROVEME-forward crossing, refusing on three `chart` findings until the dissolution was named by a hand in twelve tickets (thirteen entries); and once through criterion 11's own instrument, which found the voyage's commit carrying 45 files because it was staged with `git add -A`. STILL OPEN AND IT IS AKIEN'S: the ticket's question_for_akien - is the invariant 'every chart this component EVER made still resolves' or 'the chart of the voyage being promoted still resolves'? This build answers neither by shipping; it makes reading A affordable, which is the most that can be built without the ruling.
